entries.text: DuckDB and SQLite build their schema script with one `translate_ddl` call that also removes the TPC-DS foreign keys, instead of `translate_sql` followed by a regex strip; the generated statements are unchanged. The `ddl_helpers` regex helpers `strip_foreign_keys`, `strip_primary_keys` and `strip_tpcds_foreign_keys` are removed; the inventory keeps the `_optimize_table_definition` / `_transform_create_statement` signature detection so a reintroduced per-adapter DDL hook still fails the drift check; the `sql_compat` README, the SQLGlot and phase-aware-pipeline ADRs and the new-platform guide describe `translate_ddl` instead of per-adapter hooks.
